name.es: Tornillo de cabeza de botón M5x30
name.pt: Parafuso de cabeça de botão M5x30

description.en: An ISO 7380-1 hexagon socket button head screw, M5 × 30 mm. In a belt drive it is both a fastener and an axle: its shank passes a host's clearance hole and carries an idler's bearings, with the head bearing on the host's outer face.
description.es: Un tornillo de cabeza de botón con hexágono interior ISO 7380-1, M5 × 30 mm. En una transmisión por banda es a la vez sujetador y eje: su vástago pasa por el barreno de paso de una pieza anfitriona y lleva los rodamientos de una polea loca, con la cabeza apoyada en la cara exterior del anfitrión.
description.fr: Une vis à tête bombée à six pans creux ISO 7380-1, M5 × 30 mm. Dans une transmission par courroie, elle est à la fois fixation et axe : sa tige traverse le trou de passage d'une pièce hôte et porte les roulements d'un galet, la tête en appui sur la face extérieure de l'hôte.
description.pt: Um parafuso de cabeça de botão com sextavado interno ISO 7380-1, M5 × 30 mm. Numa transmissão por correia é ao mesmo tempo fixador e eixo: a haste passa pelo furo de passagem de uma peça hospedeira e leva os rolamentos de uma polia louca, com a cabeça apoiada na face exterior do hospedeiro.

governing.designation: ISO 7380-1 hexagon socket button head screw M5x30

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the under-head bearing face, on the screw axis. +z runs along the shank to the tip at z = 30; the head lies on the −z side. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the screw is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry. The head_seat interface is the under-head face; journal sits journal_offset_mm along the shank, where the carried part's face A lands.

label.es: Desplazamiento del asiento desde la cabeza
label.fr: Décalage de la portée depuis la tête
label.pt: Deslocamento do assento desde a cabeça

parameters.note: A convention, not a sourced fact: the distance from the under-head face to the face A of the part the shank carries (the host wall under the head plus any gap). The default 5.5 is the commons corner-idler-bracket at its defaults: a 5 mm front arm and 0.5 mm clearance to the idler.

label.es: Asiento de la cabeza (bajo la cabeza)
label.fr: Appui de la tête (sous la tête)

interfaces.note: Male: the shank enters the host's clearance hole. The origin is the centre of the under-head bearing face; the normal points +z, along the shank, toward the host, so a hole framed at the host's outer face with its normal out of the hole (female) takes the screw with the head on that face.

Male: the shank carries an idler, a flanged bearing or a shim as an axle. The origin is where the carried part's face A lands, journal_offset_mm from the under-head face; the normal points +z, toward the tip, into the carried part, whose bore is framed at its face A with the normal out of that face (female).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-E lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Retention of the tip (a nut, a tapped hole, or a pilot hole the screw cuts its own thread in) is the host's design and not modelled. Length variants are separate catalog entries: ISO 7380-1 lengths are discrete, so a length parameter would admit lengths nobody sells.

envelope.note: Head and shank; the hex socket is not hollowed. The shank overlaps the hole or pilot it is driven into: declare it.
